source_note: Borel-Cantelli lemma证明某种版本下的强大数定律
english_source_note: A Strong Law via the Borel-Cantelli Lemma
callout_id: Borel-Cantelli lemma证明某种版本下的强大数定律#5
english_title: Existence of the Expectation Is Necessary for the Strong Law of Large Numbers
statement_en: If $X_1,\ldots,X_n,\ldots$ are independent and identically distributed random variables and $E|X_1|=\infty$, and if $S_n=X_1+\cdots+X_n$, then $$P\left(\left\{\omega:\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{S_n}{n} \text{ exists}\in(-\infty,+\infty)\right\}\right)=0.$$
key_techniques: necessity argument for the strong law
prerequisites: independent and identically distributed random variables
callout_body:
如果$X_1,...,X_n,...$是独立同分布的随机变量，并且$E|X_1|=\infty$，假设$S_n = X_1+...+X_n$,那么$$P\left(\left\{\omega:\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{S_n}{n} \text{ exists}\in(-\infty,+\infty)\right\}
\right)=0$$
